_comments: The category every sales read model hangs off. One row, and it MUST be pushed before the
queries directory -- see the ordering note in metadata/.mj-sync.json, which records the trap
bizapps-orders hit and documented: 'queries' sorts before 'query-categories' alphabetically, so
without an explicit directoryOrder entry the queries are pushed first, every CategoryID lookup
fails, and the ENTIRE push halts there rather than skipping the queries.
Fixed UUID so a re-push against a rebuilt database updates this row rather than creating a
second 'Sales' category that half the queries point at.

fields.Name: Sales
fields.Description: BizApps Sales read models — the master plan §9 measures as parameterized MJ Queries. §9.5 requires these to be Queries rather than hand-rolled Angular aggregation, so Skip, the query builder and report snapshots can all reach them. Every query branches on behaviour FLAGS (IsWon, IsOpen, IncludeInCommit, IsOwnerRole) and never on a status, stage or role NAME.
